sources.title: Countis E43 MODBUS active energy meters communication table
sources.note: Whole table except reserved, command, record and date registers

notes: Checked against the Countis E43 table only. That document does not name the E33; the E33 may need the E34/E44 table (a different, older version with its own differences), so treat E33 as unconfirmed.
The slave address is at 58368 in this table, not in the 57344 group.
Addresses are the decimal addresses printed in the table, sent as written (address_base 0). Registers are read as holding registers.
Scales follow the table's unit column (for example V/100 becomes a scale of 0.01); energy counters are in kWh, kvarh and kVAh, or in 10 Wh steps in the second set.
The table gives neither function codes nor byte or word order: big-endian with the high word first is assumed (Socomec convention). Not tested on a device.
Values the table types as 8-bit sit in one 16-bit register and are read as uint16. Date and time, 64-bit, record and command registers (resets, tariff selection) are not mapped.
